options.name: clear_error
options.description: Using the flag to clear error on a device. If the error continues to exist, the device will return to an error state as soon as it is accessed.

options.name: current_pathname
options.description: Full path of the device to be added. Required while adding a device.

options.name: device_group_id
options.description: The ID of the device group. Required while adding a device. Mutually exclusive with I(device_group_name).

options.name: device_group_name
options.description: The name of the device group. Required while adding a device. Mutually exclusive with I(device_group_id).

options.name: device_id
options.description: Device ID. Mutually exclusive with I(device_name).

options.name: device_name
options.description: Device name. Mutually exclusive with I(device_id).

options.name: force
options.description: Using the Force flag to add a device. Using the flag to clear device error state without checking. Use this flag with caution, because all data on the device will be destroyed.

options.name: hostname
options.description: IP or FQDN of the PowerFlex host.

options.name: media_type
options.description: Device media types. Required while adding a device.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the PowerFlex host.

options.name: port
options.description: Port number through which communication happens with PowerFlex host.

options.name: storage_node_id
options.description: The ID of the storage node. Required while adding a device. Mutually exclusive with I(storage_node_name).

options.name: storage_node_name
options.description: The name of the storage node. Required while adding a device. Mutually exclusive with I(storage_node_id).

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time after which connection will get terminated. It is to be mentioned in seconds.

options.name: username
options.description: The username of the PowerFlex host.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Boolean variable to specify whether or not to validate SSL certificate. C(true) - Indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. C(false) - Indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.
